newsitem.title: JORDAN: French firm wins Jordan grain silos contract.
newsitem.headline: French firm wins Jordan grain silos contract.

text.p: GericoFrance signed a 10.8 million dinar contract with Jordan to expand the country's northern grain silos to help raise storage capacity to at least four months of consumption, officials said on Thursday.

The project, with 52 percent financing from the French government, will expand the northern Irbid silo storage capacity to 150,000 tonnes from 50,000, boosting the country's overall grain storage capacity to 455,000 tonnes.
The French firm, a specialist in silo construction, will begin construction work within one month under a turnkey contract to be completed within 340 days.
Other companies who bid for the project included China's Catic, Syria's Karnig-Yacoubian and Sweden's Svanska, officials said.
Officials say the extra storage facilities would allow more flexibility in the timing of grain purchases and reduce delays in vessel offloading cargo.
Jordan annual imports of wheat, corn and barley via Aqaba port are around 1.2 million tonnes.
